links.comparator_used: Unaugmented LLM (ChatGPT, LLaMa, GPT-based models) performing the medical calculations directly
links.outcome: Incorrect responses on medical calculation tasks
links.effect: 5.5-fold (88% vs 16%) reduction in incorrect responses for LLaMa and 13-fold (64% vs 4.8%) for GPT-based models with task-specific tools (OpenMedCalc) versus unimproved models
links.quote: Models with access to task-specific tools showed the greatest improvement, with LLaMa and GPT-based models demonstrating a 5.5-fold (88% vs 16%) and 13-fold (64% vs 4.8%) reduction in incorrect responses, respectively, compared to the unimproved models.
